answer: Admission auction: 100 slots per epoch; agents bid a deposit, top bids win, losers refunded. Bids sit on a crystal-clear ledger, so no operator can hide a dune of fakes. Forging 50 identities needs 50 winning bids: 200 POA each, 10,000 POA locked 20 epochs. One honest agent pays one 200 POA bid and, like a glacier, earns it back in undiluted rewards. Deposits cannot be transferred, tied to each bidder's history, so sybils pay full price per copy.
